record_title: Every proper Euler-characteristic subgroup obstructs object cotorsion completeness
provenance: A subgroup-parametrized extension of the recent parity obstruction for ideal versus object cotorsion completeness in bounded-complex Frobenius categories.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The case B=2Z is the recent Ren-Wang parity construction and is prior art. The new claim is the full Euler-characteristic subgroup family, the exact truncated-characteristic criteria, and the dichotomy that object completeness occurs exactly for B=Z. Equivalent implicit coverage in older exact-category or K0-theoretic language remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
